## What changes for users?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include a minimal example for API changes.

## Requirements and scope

Reference master-spec requirement IDs and the issue/milestone. Explain architecture or public API changes.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results. Include regression coverage and fixture provenance.

## Implications and limitations

Describe security/privacy boundaries, performance implications, and known limitations. Update docs and changelog with user-facing changes.
